sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
0. **Fact-check.** Cash USD1.45m [F58, fund record:589] ✓; current liabilities USD77.35m [F60:609] ✓; FCF −17.0/−34.0/−0.8/−22.0 [dossier:41] ✓; 3.51 Mt × USD22.69 = USD79.64m [F2/F74] ✓. Load-bearing, uncited, cross-date. [MATERIAL]

1. **Estimates.** The 7 Mt is not a permit. FY2027E 6.5 Mt rests on the KPP contract [S11], which discloses no tonnage (house:83); FY2028E 7.0 Mt is the 7.85 Mt *request* [F10] against 2.0 Mt approved [F34], with the national RKAB cut to 600 Mt from 790 Mt actual [F26/F22]. The 25-year life is an expiry-plus-extension horizon: Note 1g discloses the expiry, not the extension (house:141). Base needs ramp + extension + 10% refi at once; kill_criteria cover two. [FATAL]

2. **Variant perception.** The thesis concedes −48.7pp at Rp72. No variant: it agrees with the tape and waits for a crash. [MATERIAL]

3. **Catalyst.** None dated; the Series B is 31 days past maturity undisclosed. [MATERIAL]

4. **Base rate.** Key right, but the archetype's note says "size on the trough-survival balance sheet" — current liabilities exceed current assets by USD15.2m on USD1.45m cash. The 0.42 prior is drawn on survivors; this instance fails the archetype's stated condition. [MATERIAL]

5. **Sizing.** Kill Rp1 is a total loss, not a stop; −96.3% is honest. The entry is the defect: Rp27 is 62.5% below tape and prints only after three ARB days — only in the state where the conditioning variables have failed. p_up at fill is not 0.42; at 0.30 the entry is EV-zero (Rp27.2) and Rp20 is needed to clear 11.5%. The thesis prices its up-leg at a probability its own trigger falsifies. [FATAL]

6. **Disconfirming fact.** Note-13 funds rose USD11.40m [F13] to USD18.66m [F73] while the company borrowed USD8.03m from related parties [F50] and cash fell to USD1.45m. The USD18.66m bridge is largely controller-funded debt inside the USD77.35m of current liabilities — an asset added, never netted. [MATERIAL]

7. **Pre-mortem.** Unmentioned: suspension. Special board plus full call auction [S15/S14] means price, date and KPI kills cannot fire; the position freezes. The audit opinion is unverified (house:191) — a going-concern qualification is the tail. [MATERIAL]

8. **Integrity.** stage_log and frontmatter are ordered and stamped; estimates_committed_at 13:21:02 precedes the 13:44 file write and the body's only market datum (2026-11-04). No retro-edit detectable (file untracked; no diff history). stage_log/frontmatter integrity: clean. [MINOR]

9. **Liquidity/universe.** Not in the INDO universe, so factor UNTAGGED, a fail-closed VETO (the risk checker:396). No ADV, a VETO (the risk checker:686). Special-monitoring board vs main_board_only: true excludes it (the fund rules:65). Entry Rp27 is below min_price_idr 50 (the fund rules:64). Four independent constitutional bars; disclosure does not cure them. [FATAL]

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** The Rp27 entry is not a discount but a conditional: the only world in which this stock trades at Rp27 is the world in which the 42% prior has already failed, so the thesis prices its up-leg at a probability its own trigger falsifies.

**Stop objecting at Rp20** (10.9%/yr at p_up 0.30), and only after the board, ADV and price-floor bars are cured; no price clears a name the constitution excludes.
